ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid went down at [Location]. Courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to [Destination]. 

THREAT LEVEL – There is a strong chance that the courier was attacked by outlaws eager to acquire the vital supplies needed to stop the Molina mold out break in Levski. Medium level engagements expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier. 

FTL Courier Services thanks you for helping us do our part for Alliance Aid.
